archive_note: replicates.csv.gz is a lossless gzip archive of replicates.csv with mtime zero; produced after simulation for repository distribution.
observations: controlled multinomial draws, not LLM calls or people

plan.design: Controlled multinomial precision and identification sweep; synthetic simulation only
plan.failure_policy: Infeasible or invalid intervals retained in unconditional coverage and resolution denominators; interval width quantiles conditional on feasibility. Distinguish wrong resolutions from all unresolved or failed cases.
plan.sampling: Independent multinomial calibration columns and independent multinomial field counts in every cell and replicate. Methods within a replicate share samples.
plan.scope: No API calls, model responses, human participants, or customer observations. Population names are inherited labels; near is not an assertion of zero contrast.
